description: The main objective of this project is to develop a semantic search engine that retrieves context-aware results using meaning-based matching instead of keywords. Leveraged Hugging Face transformer embeddings for vector generation, stored embeddings in a vector database, and implemented similarity search and retrieval workflows using LangChain.
